verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a local package manager that installs software onto the user's own machine. It offers no hosted data-storage service where a storage region or residency could be chosen, so this privacy-posture axis is a category error for this kind of product. The analytics opt-out is a different control and is not region or residency selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
